user_journeys.description: General website navigation and content discovery

proposed_scenarios.scenario_name: Homepage Load and Basic Verification - Sanity Test
proposed_scenarios.description: This fundamental scenario validates that the ATID Store website is online and the homepage can be successfully loaded in a browser. It checks for the correct URL, page title, and the presence of essential structural elements, ensuring the site's basic availability for users. This is a critical smoke test to run before any other functional tests.
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Validate that the website's primary entry point is accessible and renders correctly, confirming the site is online and available to all potential customers.
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As a new visitor, I want to successfully load the homepage, so that I can begin browsing the store's products and services.

detailed_steps.action: Navigate to the ATID Store homepage
detailed_steps.description: Initiate the test by navigating the browser directly to the ATID Store's main URL, https://atid.store/. The test should wait for the page to completely load, indicated by the network activity becoming idle. This ensures all initial HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and image assets are downloaded and rendered. The primary goal is to confirm the server is responsive and the homepage is served without errors. This step is the foundation for all subsequent user interactions and tests on the website.

selector_reference.selection_reason: This is a 'navigate' action which does not require an element selector. The selector pool was also empty, providing no options for selection.

detailed_steps.wait_strategy: Wait for the browser's page load event to complete, specifically waiting for the 'networkidle' state. This confirms that all initial static assets and API calls have finished. Allow a generous timeout of up to 15 seconds to account for varying network conditions or a slow initial server response. The wait is necessary to ensure the page is fully interactive before any verification checks are performed.
detailed_steps.verification_strategy: Verify that the final browser URL is exactly 'https://atid.store/'. Check that the page's HTML title tag contains text relevant to the store, such as 'ATID Store' or 'Home'. A visual check for a main header or navigation bar element would also confirm a successful render, though no selectors are available for this. The key acceptance criteria is the absence of any browser-level errors (e.g., 404 Not Found, 500 Server Error).
detailed_steps.error_recovery: If the page fails to load within the 15-second timeout, the test should retry the navigation up to two more times. If all attempts fail, capture a screenshot of the browser error page and fail the test with a clear message: 'CRITICAL: Homepage at https://atid.store/ failed to load after 3 attempts.' This indicates a major site outage or connectivity issue.
detailed_steps.business_context: Establishes the initial point of contact for any user journey. If the homepage doesn't load, no business can be conducted.

expected_results: The user is successfully navigated to https://atid.store/.
The page loads completely within a reasonable timeframe (e.g., under 15 seconds) without any HTTP or browser console errors.
The page title is correctly set and reflects the identity of the store.
edge_cases_to_test: Attempting to load the page with http instead of https to see if it redirects correctly.
Loading the URL with a trailing slash vs. without to ensure both resolve to the same page.
Throttling network speed to simulate a user on a slow connection and observing load behavior.
data_requirements: The exact URL of the homepage: https://atid.store/
prerequisites: A stable internet connection for the test runner.
The ATID Store website must be deployed and publicly accessible.
